name: Mouse Tooltip Translator
summary: Translates text when you hover over it, including text in PDFs and images (OCR), and shows dual subtitles on YouTube and Netflix. Translation is done by Google Translate and Bing.
audience: Language learners and readers of foreign-language sites, PDFs and subtitles.
pros: Hover translation without leaving the page
Handles PDFs, text inside images (OCR) and read-aloud
Dual subtitles for YouTube and Netflix
cons: Translation comes from Google Translate and Bing, not from an AI chat model
The listing's privacy section lists user activity among the data it handles
pricing_note: The store page states no price; the source code is public on GitHub.
alternatives: Manga Translator - Comics Translator | Manga Tracker
